_note: Side quests. A villager offers one when the condition in 'giver' holds for them at dawn. 'need' is goods the player hands over (they go to the giver); 'kill' names a target ('robber': the bandit who robbed the giver). 'reward' is coins the giver pays from their own purse, in full (set aside at acceptance). Lines are spoken by the giver: {need} is replaced by the goods asked for, {target} by the target's name. Story quests ('story': true) are not offered from needs: every player starts with them, and their giver shows the story marker (a green pennant) until they are done; 'learn' names a spell the giver teaches. docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md, 'Side quests'. 'marker' is the icon over a giver with that offer (game/assets/markers/: skill, food, mineral, combat, wood, tool; default skill). 'teach' raises a player skill to a level when the quest is done; 'player_below' offers it only to a player below that level. Paid work ('hire': true) is never offered at dawn: a villager whose condition holds and who has the 'wage' offers it when the player asks for work; 'wage' is paid in full from their purse; 'harvest' lets the player cut that much wheat from the employer's field ('field_ripe': at least that much ripe) without theft; undone work lapses after 'days'. Promised rewards and wages are set aside when the player accepts, and quests are offered only by someone who can pay them (owner, 2026-10-18). A template marked 'retired' is never offered, hired or accepted again; an accepted one already in a save is finished or lapses by the usual rules. Wages and the jobs chosen are agent proposals, provisional: balance review pending (docs/BUILD_DECISIONS.md, 'Paid work for the player').

quests.title: The sage in the north
quests.start: They say a sage lives in a hut at the north edge of the village, and that he teaches fire to those who can pay.
quests.offer: So you found me. Fire answers to those who learn its words. Fifty coins, and I will teach you to call it.
quests.waiting: Fifty coins, and the fire is yours. Come back when you have them.
quests.thanks: Speak the words, and keep your hand steady. Fire does not forgive the careless.

quests.title: The tanner's craft
quests.offer: My vats are near empty. Bring me {need} and I'll show you how leather is cut and stitched into armour. That's worth more than coin.
quests.waiting: No hides yet? Boar in the woods give good ones.
quests.thanks: Good hides. Now watch: cut along the grain, stitch double at the shoulder. You can make leather armour now.

quests.title: Ore for the forge
quests.offer: My forge goes cold without iron. Bring me {need} and I'll pay you twenty coins.
quests.waiting: Still no ore? The fire won't wait forever.
quests.thanks: Good iron, that. Here's your pay, as I said.

quests.title: Wood for the hearth
quests.offer: I can't cook on a cold stove. Fetch me {need} and there's ten coins in it.
quests.thanks: That'll keep the pot boiling. Thank you.

quests.title: A new axe
quests.offer: My axe broke on a knot and I can't work without one. Bring me {need} and I'll pay what it's worth.
quests.waiting: No axe yet? Every day without one is a day without pay.
quests.thanks: A fine edge. Back to the trees for me.

quests.title: Food for the family
quests.offer: There's little in our pot and the young ones are hungry. Could you bring {need}? It's not much I can give you.
quests.waiting: The children ask when you'll come.
quests.thanks: Bless you. They'll sleep with full bellies tonight.

quests.title: Bandit trouble
quests.offer: {target} robbed me on the road. Deal with that thief and I'll give you what I can.
quests.thanks: So {target} is gone. I can walk the road again. Take this.

quests.title: Work the harvest
quests.offer: My wheat is ripe and I can't cut it all myself. Bring in {need} from my field and I'll pay you {wage} coins for the day.
quests.waiting: The wheat won't cut itself. {need} from my field, then come to me.
quests.thanks: That's a good day's work. Here's your wage, as I said.
quests.unpaid: I can't pay you just now. Come back when I've sold some grain.

quests.title: A day in the woods
quests.offer: The carpenters want more than I can fell. Bring me {need} and I'll pay you {wage} coins. You'll need your own axe.
quests.thanks: Good straight logs. Here's your wage.
quests.unpaid: I can't pay you yet. Let me sell what I have first.

quests.title: A shift in the mine
quests._retired: Owner decision OD-01, 2026-10-21 (docs/directives/2026-10-21_build17_od01_final_decisions.md): retired. Never offered again; miners earn by selling at negotiated prices or through CON-01 contracts. Kept only so a shift already accepted in an older save can be finished (its wage was set aside at acceptance) or lapse with the wage returned.
quests.offer: The smiths want iron and my arms are tired. Dig me {need} and I'll pay you {wage} coins. Bring your own pick.
quests.thanks: That's honest ore. Here's your wage.
quests.unpaid: I can't pay you yet. The smiths owe me; come back later.
